data.about_content:
Chandigarh University Online (CU Online) provides a well-rounded Online MBA degree with a specialization in Banking and Insurance, which prepares students with the knowledge and abilities to succeed in the evolving financial services sector. The Online MBA in Banking & Insurance by Chandigarh University 2-year postgraduate degree course is delivered online, ensuring flexibility for working professionals and graduates who wish to boost their careers in banking and insurance without professional break.

The Chandigarh University Online MBA in Banking & Insurance curriculum blends fundamental business courses with specialized courses in banking operations, insurance administration, and finance analysis to upskill candidates with a comprehensive approach to the finance industry. The Banking & Insurance Online MBA by Chandigarh University emphasizes practical exposure with HBPE & KPMG empowered courses included in the program.

Chandigarh University Online provides an easy EMI facility that provides a no-cost facility without any hidden charges. The Online MBA in Banking & Insurance EMI details at Chandigarh University Online are listed below:

  • 24 Months EMI: INR 7,078 /-
  • 12 Months EMI: INR 13,750 /-
  • 18 Months EMI: INR 9,166 /-
data.eligibility_content: A candidate with a valid bachelor’s degree is eligible to apply.
data.admission_steps:
Step 1. Visit the official university online admission portal and register.

Step 2. Fill in personal, contact, and academic details in the application form.

Step 3. Upload scanned copies of required documents (graduation marksheet, ID proof, photograph).

Step 4. Pay the program admission fee online to confirm your enrollment.
data.syllabus_content:
The Chandigarh University online MBA in Banking & Insurance syllabus follows a semester pattern and includes industry-centric courses such as Principles and Practices of Banking Operations, Marketing Management, Financial Accounting, Financial Management, Credit Analysis and Bank Advances, and Insurance Management. These courses are strategically designed to equip students with the in-depth knowledge and practical skills necessary for banking and insurance professionals.

For better reference, a detailed program syllabus is attached in the table below:

Year I

Semester I

  • Business, Society and Law
  • Financial Reporting and Analysis
  • Management Practice and Organizational Behavior
  • Decision Science
  • Managerial Economics
  • Marketing Management
  • Communication Skills

Semester II

  • Human Resource Management
  • Supply Chain & Logistics Management
  • Consumer Psychology
  • Business Research Methods
  • Financial Management
  • Productions & Operations Management
  • Professional Communication Skills

Year II

Semester III

  • Strategy, Business and Globalization
  • Data Analysis for Business Decisions
  • Management Lessons from Ancient India
  • Merchant Banking & Financial Services
  • Legal Aspect of Banking
  • Treasury & Risk Management
  • Corporate Insurance Management

Semester IV

  • Project Management
  • Values and Ethics
  • Academic Research Writing/Industry Immersion /International Project/Social Outreach Initiatives/Case Writing/Rural Immersion
  • Mutual funds and portfolio management
  • Banking & Insurance Management

faqs.question: What is the Chandigarh University Online MBA in Banking & Insurance, and who is eligible to apply?
faqs.answer: The Chandigarh University Online MBA in Banking & Insurance is 24 month master's degree program that is delivered through an online learning mode and holds the same value as a traditional MBA degree. Simultaneously, a candidate with a valid bachelor’s degree is eligible to apply.

faqs.question: How does the Online MBA in Banking & Insurance at Chandigarh University help in career advancement?
faqs.answer: Globally recognized degree, 24*7 learning support, internationally acclaimed faculty, and Harvard and KPMG empowered course facilities assist in the career advancement of students enrolled in Chandigarh University online MBA in banking and insurance.

faqs.question: What key subjects are covered in the Chandigarh University MBA in Banking & Insurance Online?
faqs.answer: Legal Aspects of Banking, Treasury & Risk Management, Corporate Insurance Management, Mutual funds and portfolio management, and Banking & Insurance Management are the key subjects covered in the Chandigarh University MBA in Banking & Insurance Online.

faqs.question: Is the Chandigarh University Online MBA in Banking & Insurance UGC-approved?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Chandigarh University Online MBA in Banking & Insurance is UGC-approved.

faqs.question: What is the duration and fee structure of the Chandigarh University MBA in Banking & Insurance Online?
faqs.answer: The Chandigarh University MBA in Banking & Insurance Online is a 2 year program that costs INR 1,65,000 /-.
